summary: The body is now SOTN bios.c CD_getsector line for line. The pointers are verified against the EXE words 91C98.data.s: 0x1F801018 CDROM delay, 0x1F801020 COM_DELAY, 0x1F8010F0 DPCR, 0x1F8010B0/B4/B8 D3 MADR/BCR/CHCR. The new macro names are true: 0x80 written to reg3 at index 0 is the request register's BFRD bit; 0x40 in reg0 is the data-request bit. The redundant v1/v0 locals and the guarded do-while are gone. Nothing left to label.
